title: Whistler Shooting Adventures
specs: Shooting on 20m, 50m, and 100m ranges with reactive steel targets
Located at Pemberton Wildlife Association Shooting Range, 20 minutes north of Whistler
Minimum age 10 years, must be physically large enough to hold firearms safely
Minors must be accompanied by parent or legal guardian
No firearms license required; supervised by Range Officer
Government issued ID required for clients 18 and over
Pregnant women not recommended to participate due to lead exposure
No drug or alcohol impairment allowed; zero tolerance policy
Minimum reservation 2 people; no single shooter reservations
Can accommodate groups; catering available on request

blurb: Guests shoot a variety of firearms on 20m, 50m, and 100m ranges with reactive steel targets. All packages include detailed instructions, safety supervision, ear and eye protection. Minors 10 years and older are welcome with supervision; no experience or permits required.
extraNote: Minimum reservation is 2 people; no single shooter reservations accepted · Reservations required; same day accepted if available · 24 hour cancellation notice is fully refundable · 15% staff gratuity added to groups of 4 or more · If showing signs of impairment, asked to leave and forfeit deposit · Pemberton Wildlife Association Shooting Range, about 20 minutes north of Whistler. No street address; see directions on site. · Year-round, winter hours more limited due to daylight and snow
